creationPrompt:
Create a dataset guide for me as a Claw Me Page. Include unit of observation, quality checks, responsible reuse. Use the Claw Me source at https://github.com/clawdotme/plugin in templates/dataset-guide/index.html and templates/_shared/tailwind/README.md. Use semantic responsive HTML, working section links, and useful native details/summary interactions. No scripts, forms, tracking, or embedded frames in the static Page. PDF export is separate from Page publishing unless the current platform explicitly supports it.

exampleAnswers.Purpose and audience: A dataset guide with field definitions, units, provenance, and quality checks.
exampleAnswers.Working context: This fictional dataset records handover tasks in a small usability exercise. The field examples describe a schema; they do not contain real participant information.
exampleAnswers.Example records:
Field: record_id · Type: Text · Meaning: Unique observation identifier · Example: R-001
Field: variant · Type: Text · Meaning: Assigned document layout · Example: Index
Field: completed · Type: Boolean · Meaning: Task met the defined check · Example: true
Field: duration_seconds · Type: Integer · Meaning: Elapsed task time · Example: 95
Field: issue_note · Type: Text · Meaning: Non-identifying observation · Example: Opened old draft first
exampleAnswers.Content decisions:
Unit of observation: One row represents one task attempt. A participant who performs several tasks may have several rows, so row count is not automatically participant count.
Quality checks: Require unique record identifiers, known variant values, nonnegative durations, and a consistent completion definition. Record missing values explicitly instead of substituting zero.
Responsible reuse: Keep identifying data out of the analysis extract. Document collection dates, consent, transformations, and permitted uses in the actual dataset record before sharing it.
exampleAnswers.Format and interaction: manual layout; section navigation and expandable detail where useful; matching portrait document PDF.
exampleAnswers.Sharing and provenance: A hypothetical example informed by Claw Me’s small-team and Agent workflows. These are not Pete’s actual clients, finances, travel plans, research results, or commitments. Keep the real adaptation private until the owner chooses to share.
